label: REPLAY (no key)
limit: The 10k pack is not on this machine. These numbers are the committed 100-patient fixture (115 patient rows, 100 living). Type 2 diabetes has no HbA1c result in March 2026 in this fixture, so question 1 is answered on every HbA1c result.

questions.answer: Naive HbA1c control (value under 7, ignoring units) went from 100% in February 2026 (1 of 1, percent) to 75% in March 2026 (3 of 4). The March result that fails is 44 mmol/mol. A percent threshold treats that unit as out of range. The type 2 cohort has no March 2026 HbA1c row in this fixture.
questions.sql: select strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') as mon, units, count(*) as n, min(value_num) as lo, max(value_num) as hi from 'PACK/parquet/observations.parquet' where code = '4548-4' and date >= DATE '2026-02-01' and date < DATE '2026-04-01' group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

questions.answer: November 2023 had the fewest visits, 23. Prenatal visits were the largest type, 5 of those 23.
questions.sql: select strftime(date_trunc('month', start), '%Y-%m') as mon, count(*) as n from 'PACK/parquet/encounters.parquet' group by 1 order by n asc, mon asc limit 1
questions.types_sql: select description, count(*) as n from 'PACK/parquet/encounters.parquet' where strftime(date_trunc('month', start), '%Y-%m') = '2023-11' group by 1 order by n desc limit 1

questions.answer: The busiest 10% of patients account for 624 of 1322 visits (47.2%).
questions.sql: with per as (select patient, count(*) as n from 'PACK/parquet/encounters.parquet' group by 1), ranked as (select n, ntile(10) over (order by n desc, patient) as decile from per) select sum(n) filter (where decile = 1), sum(n) from ranked
